node.title: Rank-eleven chronology-safe subspace-cover payment
node.closure: exact weighted payment for first-match partitions of the nontransverse rank-eleven residue into correction subspaces
node.statement: At the official KoalaBear rank-eleven full-span terminal (tau=1679,h=38384), partition the represented nontransverse row spaces into classes C_alpha, each contained in a correction subspace V_alpha of dimension d_alpha<=9. First-match ownership, ordinary affine-span, and sub-square interleaving bound the complete nontransverse slope contribution by sum_alpha R_(d_alpha), where R_d=(n-A) floor(C(n-K+d,d)/C(A-K+d,d)). The residual allowance is 65167969673715470, so every unsafe survivor has sum_alpha R_(d_alpha)>65167969673715470. Uniform-cover first-unsafe class counts for d=1..9 are 4420641497,262093370,16384884,1027929,64502,4048,254,16,2. In particular, two five-dimensional blocks are paid, and an unsafe 2x5 factor presentation must use at least 64502 distinct factor slices. No cover existence or locator synchronization is claimed.
